create_trec_eval_metric: create a TREC evaluation metric that computes precision and nDCG scores for ranked document retrieval
compute_trec_eval_scores: compute TREC evaluation scores including MAP, nDCG, precision@k, and reciprocal rank from run and qrel data
evaluate_retrieval_rankings: evaluate information retrieval rankings by comparing predicted document scores against relevance judgments
calculate_precision_at_k: calculate precision at multiple cutoffs (5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 100, 200, 500, 1000) for retrieved documents
calculate_ndcg_at_k: calculate normalized discounted cumulative gain at multiple cutoffs (5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 100, 200, 500, 1000) for ranked results
